summary: A named group of MenuItems. Re-exported from react-stately's collection Section — `title` is Figma's Menu Section Title.
useWhen: a Menu has more than one kind of action, such as editing actions and destructive ones
the rows fall into groups the user scans by name

useInstead.why: a single section adds a heading the user must hear before every menu, and says nothing the menu's own label does not

composition.note: A collection element: Menu reads it from its direct children. With `title`, the heading is drawn with a rule after it; without one, `aria-label` names the group and a rule is drawn above it instead.

guarantees: the group is named by its title, so a screen reader announces it on entering the first row
requires: a `title`; an untitled section still needs a label for the group, or it is announced as an unnamed group
notes: The accessible-name lint rule is deliberately not driven from here: a titled section is named by its title and needs nothing more, so demanding a label on every MenuSection would be wrong for the common case.

antiPatterns.why: a menu has one level of grouping; a section inside a section renders nothing
